body:
## Change

F1. Verify candidate.json canonical bytes alongside existing manifest/pointer checks. Producer already emits canonical candidate metadata; verifier previously accepted equivalent pretty-printed bytes despite canonical JSON contract.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN first validates original candidate then alters only formatting and expects CONTENT_INVALID_MANIFEST. Parent reviewed producer/check boundary and contract; reran full 24-test producer suite. Worker related/boundaries: 55; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Canonical form check is metadata contract enforcement, not authentication or protection against authorized metadata rewriting. Synthetic local fixtures only; no live publication. Full repo gates not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(content): reject noncanonical producer candidates
